Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) iPhone Buyers Seeking Higher-End Models
A larger-than-expected percentage of likely Apple (AAPL) iPhone buyers is looking to get higher-end models this product cycle, a Wall Street firm said Monday.
The iPhone’s average selling price could reach $780 in fiscal 2019. That’s if the midrange iPhone XR sells better than expected, he said. Olson said his current expectation is for the iPhone XR to get 30% of iPhone sales this cycle. The 6.1-inch LCD-screen iPhone XR goes on sale Oct. 26 after a week of preorders.
“Considering Apple has not yet started marketing for iPhone XR, we expect interest for that device to grow in the coming weeks,” Olson said in a note to clients.
Olson maintained his overweight rating on Apple stock with a price target of 250.
Apple shares rose 0.7% to 227.26 on the stock market today. It is just below its all-time high of 229.67, reached on Sept. 5.

A black body occurred (because prices closed lower than they opened). During the past 10 bars, there have been 5 white candles and 5 black candles. During the past 50 bars, there have been 28 white candles and 22 black candles for a net of 6 white candles.
A rising window occurred (where the top of the previous shadow is below the bottom of the current shadow). This usually implies a continuation of a bullish trend. There have been 5 rising windows in the last 50 candles–this makes the current rising window even more bullish.
Momentum Indicators
Momentum is a general term used to describe the speed at which prices move over a given time period. Generally, changes in momentum tend to lead to changes in prices. This expert shows the current values of four popular momentum indicators.
Stochastic Oscillator
One method of interpreting the Stochastic Oscillator is looking for overbought areas (above 80) and oversold areas (below 20). The Stochastic Oscillator is 85.1738. This is an overbought reading. However, a signal is not generated until the Oscillator crosses below 80 The last signal was a buy 7 period(s) ago.
Relative Strength Index (RSI)
The RSI shows overbought (above 70) and oversold (below 30) areas. The current value of the RSI is 62.51. This is not a topping or bottoming area. A buy or sell signal is generated when the RSI moves out of an overbought/oversold area. The last signal was a sell 17 period(s) ago.
Commodity Channel Index (CCI)
The CCI shows overbought (above 100) and oversold (below -100) areas. The current value of the CCI is 147.This is an overbought reading. However, a signal isn’t generated until the indicator crosses below 100. The last signal was a buy 7 period(s) ago.
MACD
The Moving Average Convergence/Divergence indicator (MACD) gives signals when it crosses its 9 period signal line. The last signal was a buy 0 period(s) ago.
